desc:
⚽ Color My Soccer Team 🏆

🎨 Color famous football club logos with their correct colors!
🧠 Test your football knowledge, compete against your opponent, and aim for the highest accuracy!
🏆 The more accurate you are, the better your chances of winning!
🌍 Think you know football? Prove it and become the ultimate football expert!

👍 Like and Favorite ⭐ to support the game and stay updated!

✨ Thanks for playing!

DISCLAIMER: This is a fan-made game and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any football club, league, or organization featured in the game. All names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
